errors.evidence: Description erroneously states each category is represented by a single bar, but in reality, the bars are grouped by color (blue and red) representing two visual categories.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart is about measures important for limiting the 'hidden economy' in the country, which is indicated in the chart title.
The description does not mention that the chart title is posed as a question suggesting survey-based data collection.
The description does not mention the text for the percentage values on the bars, which are part of the visual representation.
